item.title: Netanyahu on Iran: We are working to bring down this regime and defeat it
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an interview with Neve Dromi on i24NEWS that Israel has not yet completed its mission in Iran.
“All of our systems, under my direction, are working to bring down this regime and defeat it," he said.

item.title: Iranian media: Death toll of strikes rise to 18
item.description: Iranian media reported that the death toll from the strikes in the country has risen to 18. According to the reports, another 109 people were injured.

item.title: Herzog reveals roll of terrorist who was arrested
item.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed the arrest of Hamas terrorist Muin al-Arbid in an interview with CNN, calling it “a very important step toward achieving the objective."
Herzog said al-Arbid was responsible for efforts to thwart attempts to remove Hamas from power in Gaza and disarm the terrorist organization, as well as “the way the hostages were held in the tunnels."

item.title: Trump suggests changing Strait of Hormuz to Trump Strait
item.description:
US President Donald Trump shared post suggesting the name of the Strait of Hormuz be changed to the "Trump Strait."
"Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be “hotter" than ever before," he wrote on Truth Social.
